description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy on Green Gram, Oranges etc., w.e.f. 08.11.2018
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It constitutes a regulatory order that establishes new tax rates on specific commodities, which falls under the category of Legal/Regulatory matters (new regulations, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements). While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa, it does so only to establish the authority making the order and does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or personnel changes that would make it a government-related type (1-3).
